content: qmd README (primary): MCP tools = query/get/multi_get/status/metadata. query params: searches array (lex/vec/hyde subqueries 1-10, first gets 2x weight), collections, filter, intent, limit, minScore, candidateLimit, rerank (default true); unknown params silently ignored. get: path | #docid | path:from:count, fromLine/maxLines/lineNumbers; multi_get: pattern, maxBytes (10240 default), maxLines, lineNumbers. Filter semantics: typed exact match no coercion, arrays are sets, missing keys do not match ne/nin, no implicit AND. Defaults: embeddinggemma-300M-GGUF Q8_0, Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B-Q8_0, qmd-query-expansion-1.7B q4_k_m (fine-tuned); auto-download on first use to ~/.cache/qmd/models/, qmd pull prefetch, progress hidden by default (--progress). Install npm/bun -g @tobilu/qmd, Node>=22. MCP: stdio default; --http localhost:8181 POST /mcp stateless JSON + POST /query,/metadata + GET /health; --daemon PID ~/.cache/qmd/mcp.pid, mcp stop; Origin/Host validation vs DNS rebinding, QMD_ALLOWED_ORIGINS/HOSTS, endpoints unauthenticated. Claude Code plugin: claude plugin marketplace add tobi/qmd; claude plugin install qmd@qmd. No skill packaging mentioned.
